title: Driving School Website Case Study: An Adelaide Rebrand
description: Driving school website case study: an Adelaide rebrand, a domain move with 301 redirects and a WhatsApp booking site now getting around 300 clicks a month.
dek: How we rebranded an Adelaide driving school, moved it to a new domain and built a WhatsApp booking site now getting around 300 clicks a month.

faq.q: Can I change my business name without losing Google rankings?
faq.a: Yes, if you plan it. Keep the old domain, redirect every old page to its matching new page with 301 redirects, update your Google Business Profile and listings, and tell Google about the move in Search Console.

faq.q: Is WhatsApp a good booking channel for a service business?
faq.a: For businesses where customers want to ask a quick question first, like driving schools, trades and beauty services, it often works better than a form. It feels personal and low-pressure.

faq.q: What should a driving school website include?
faq.a: Clear services and prices, the suburbs you cover, your reviews, instructor details and credentials, answers to common learner questions, and one easy way to book.

related_blurb: Nunik Co. handles rebrands, domain moves with full redirects and fast websites built around the way your customers like to book.
